headlines.title: Fact checking Trump's birthright citizenship claims
headlines.description: President Trump signs new executive orders aiming to impose further restrictions on birthright citizenship, despite a recent Supreme Court ruling upholding the law. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor joins Meet the Press NOW to fact check the president's claims.

headlines.title: Sen. Mitch McConnell says he's out of rehab and recovering at home
headlines.description: Senator Mitch McConnell (R-KY) is now out of rehab and recovering at home after a fall he suffered in mid-June. NBC News' Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: Michigan says salad is safe again as state’s cyclosporiasis cases fall
headlines.description: The state health department said residents can resume buying bagged salads but should still avoid recalled lettuce.

headlines.title: Perez Hilton’s family says his children ‘fled’ their home before his reported self-harm livestream
headlines.description: The family said they “fled to protect from witnessing any further trauma” after “it became clear” that Hilton was “harming himself.”

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Remains found in yard in search for missing couple, police say son may have left country
headlines.description: The remains of two people were found in an Arizona backyard Thursday as police searched for a missing father and mother whose son is believed to have fled the country, police said.

headlines.title: Groups challenge FCC approval of startup’s plan to beam on-demand sunlight from space
headlines.description: The environmental organizations argue a test mission could pave the way for a much larger constellation of satellites in the future.
